item.title: Life is meaningless, the things you love are a con, and anger takes strength
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: meaninglessness is not bad news, and neither is the con. What has to be budgeted is strength — anger is physical work, and there is less of it every year. 1. Uncover the floor first# tap to enlarge Life has no meaning, and it arrived by accident.
